body:
# Masquerade - resource pack for minecraft.

Welcome to the unique Masquerade resource pack, which transforms traditional carved pumpkins into masks of cute mobs! If you are tired of ordinary pumpkins and want to give your Minecraft world a new and exciting look on Halloween Eve and beyond, then this resource pack is exactly what you need.

### How to use this RP?

To get a mask, it is enough to rename the carved pumpkin in the anvil to the name of the mask that you need

### Use the following NBT tags in the anvil:

_allay, axelotl, bat, bee, breeze, chicken, creeper, ender_dragon, enderman, fox, panda, pig, shulker, skeleton, slime, strider, warden, wither._
